summary.headline: Finding the Lord of the Year
summary.text: Chapters V and VI explain how to determine the lord of the year: select the strongest planet at the hour of revolution, then assess planetary parts and testimonies by house position, angularity, the ascendant, exaltation, triplicity, terms, and hour lord across the seven climates.
